DashboardSupport.p1: We generally don't ask, but today we need your help. Lattice OS is an independent project built to give people a memory-native AI operating layer without forcing them into a single provider.

Metadata.title: Lattice OS: Memory-Native AI That Remembers Your Work
Metadata.description: Lattice OS is a memory-native AI platform where conversations, code, and documents share persistent context — unlike ChatGPT and Claude that forget every session, Lattice compounds knowledge over time.
Metadata.keywords: Lattice OS, memory-native AI, persistent memory, persistent context, AI workspace, model routing, UCOL, code intelligence, document reasoning, AI that remembers

hero.badge: Memory-native AI · Persistent Context · Runtime Routing
hero.subhead: Lattice is a memory-native AI workspace where conversations, code, and documents share persistent context — built so your AI remembers more than the latest prompt.
hero.title: The memory-native AI layer for evolving projects
hero.description: Work with memory-aware conversations, persistent context, and runtime routing that grows with your projects over time.

ucol.title: Different work deserves different runtime paths.
ucol.subtitle: Lattice routes work across different operating modes and model paths using task shape, memory state, and system intent — while keeping persistent memory and prepared context at the center.
ucol.card1Body: Use different operating modes for different kinds of work instead of forcing every request through one flat response path.
ucol.card2Body: Escalate to stronger reasoning and higher-quality paths when the task justifies it, instead of paying the same cost for every interaction.
ucol.card3Body: Keep one evolving memory layer across conversations, projects, and future capability surfaces so useful knowledge does not reset every session.
ucol.card4Body: Resolve behavior on the server side using mode, context, and system logic — not just manual model switching in the UI.

memory.title: Your AI shouldn't forget you every session
memory.subtitle: Unlike ChatGPT and Claude that start from scratch every conversation, Lattice builds persistent memory, prepared context, and retrieval-aware assembly so your project state, prior work, and knowledge compound over time.
memory.stat1Label: Memory that carries across sessions and conversations
memory.stat2Label: Structured context instead of raw transcript sprawl
memory.stat3Label: Knowledge that improves as the system is used

features.title: A memory-native AI system, not just a chat wrapper
features.subtitle: Lattice combines persistent memory, runtime routing, document and project understanding, and trusted capability growth into one evolving workspace experience.
features.conversationDesc: Work inside an AI workspace shaped by persistent memory and project context instead of behaving like a disposable prompt window.
features.codeDesc: Move toward deeper repo, architecture, and project-aware workflows instead of treating code as isolated snippets.
features.researchDesc: Use persistent context and structured memory to support deeper analysis, synthesis, and evolving research workflows.
features.hybridDesc: Let the system choose different inference paths for different kinds of work instead of collapsing every task into one generic lane.
features.memoryLayerDesc: Build on a memory foundation designed to persist and compound knowledge across every conversation and project.
features.infrastructureDesc: Grow from the hosted workspace into desktop and local execution paths with explicit trust and observability boundaries.

cta.title: Start with an AI that actually remembers
cta.subtitle: Memory-native conversations, persistent project context, and runtime routing — built to grow with your work, not reset every session.

pricing.title: Flexible Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay only for what you generate.
pricing.disclaimer: Prices are estimated based on standard usage.

infrastructure.title: Use the hosted workspace today. Grow into trusted local capability over time.
infrastructure.subtitle: Lattice already spans an authenticated AI workspace, structured backend routing, and an emerging desktop/local execution path. The direction is controlled capability growth inside explicit trust boundaries — not unconstrained automation.
infrastructure.card1Body: Start with the core web workspace for conversations, documents, and project context without needing the local capability stack on day one.
infrastructure.card2Body: Runtime behavior is increasingly resolved in the server layer so routing, context, and system decisions are more inspectable and dependable.
infrastructure.card3Body: Electron packaging and the Go harness are laying the groundwork for scoped local file, repo, and runtime capabilities.
infrastructure.card4Body: Local capability is being developed in bounded phases with explicit scoping, denial behavior, telemetry, and observability goals.
